SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.gmRecords: The positioning successes count toward next turn's Driver Points once the GM runs the turn (the GM's Vehicle chase tool).
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.hidden: {name} breaks contact with {from}: an Escape Bonus of {bonus} on its Driver Points until it is relocated.
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.noCombat: The book's chase needs a started combat (its Maneuver Scores are kept on the combat).
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.noOpponents: {name} isn't in a chase with anyone.
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.noVehicles: No vehicles are in a chase. Select the vehicles, or start a chase from a vehicle sheet.
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.notRelocated: {name} doesn't find it (NPC drivers give up after {turns} Combat Turns).
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.positioned: Positioning: {a} +{as}, {b} +{bs} Driver Points next Combat Turn.
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.scoreRow: {name}: partial {partial}, Open Test {open} (Control Pool {cp}), Driver Points {driver}: Maneuver Score {score}
SR2E.VDrive98.Chase.scoresHint: Passengers may take offensive actions only in Combat Phases up to their vehicle's Driver Points (Rigger 2 p. 49).
SR2E.VDrive98.Mod.hidden: The vehicle is hiding (its Hiding successes)
SR2E.VDrive98.Mod.overSpeedHide: Hiding above the Speed (+2 in all)
SR2E.VDrive98.Passenger.applied: {vehicle} takes Light damage from the hit on its passenger (unresisted): {after}/{max} boxes.
SR2E.VDrive98.Passenger.deadly: A Deadly hit on {name} also does Light damage to {vehicle}, unresisted (Rigger 2 p. 53).
SR2E.VDrive98.Passenger.title: A Deadly hit on a passenger
SR2E.VDrive98.Sheet.autonavOffHint: An active autonav hinders combat maneuvers (+ its rating; ramming + rating + 2) but adds its dice to ordinary Driving and Crash Tests. Turning it on or off is a Simple Action (free when jumped in).
SR2E.VDrive98.Sheet.beltedHint: Everyone aboard wears a seat belt: crash and collision damage one level lower. APPS halves the Power; a crash cage adds 6 dice.
SR2E.VDrive98.Sheet.stressHint: Stress Points: +1 for each speed-up past the Speed; +1D6 when a Driving Test rolls as many 1s as the skill; a failed Driving Test rolls 2D6 against it. At twice the Body a system fails.
SR2E.VDrive98.Sheet.suspensionHint: Without it a ground vehicle off-road has half its Speed.
SR2E.VDrive98.Sheet.typeHint: The Maneuver Score's vehicle type (Vehicle Points); empty: by its category.
SR2E.VDrive98.Stress.breaks: Stress {stress} is twice the Body or more: a major system fails.
SR2E.VDrive98.Stress.gmSet: GM: set the vehicle's Stress to {stress}.
SR2E.VDrive98.Stress.ruleOfOne: Stress Rule of One ({ones} ones): +{add} Stress, now {stress}.
SR2E.VDrive98.Stress.testFails: Stress Test {total} below Stress {stress}: a major system fails.
SR2E.VDrive98.Stress.testHolds: Stress Test {total} against Stress {stress}: no failure.
SR2E.VDrive98.Text.partHolds: Not enough damage to knock out the {part}.
SR2E.VDrive98.Text.speedCapped: {name} can't go faster than {max} (1.5 × its Speed).
SR2E.VDrive98.Tool.hint: Run the Maneuver Scores at the start of every Combat Turn (all vehicles in chases, or the selected ones). Hide, Relocate and Hit a wall need one selected vehicle.
SR2E.VDrive98.Tool.title: Vehicle chase (book rules)
SR2E.VDrive98.Wall.stops: {name} hits the wall at {speed} (Barrier {barrier}) and stops against it.
SR2E.VDrive98.Why.hidden: {target} has broken contact with {vehicle}: relocate it first.
SR2E.VDrive98.Why.passengerPhase: {name} rides in {vehicle}: no offensive action in Combat Phase {phase}, above its Driver Points ({points}).
SR2E.VDrive98.Why.ramTooFar: {name} is {gap} m from {target}: a ram needs less than its Acceleration ({accel}). Accelerate first.
SR2E.VDrive98.ownerOnly: Only {name}'s owner or the GM can do that.
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__offRoad: Off-road Speed: half off-road without off-road suspension, Rigger 2 p. 22 (book) or the same (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__riggerD: Rigger defaulting: jumped in, +1 per dot from Reaction or a vehicle skill, Rigger 2 p. 12 (book) or the full modifier (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__autonav: Autonav in combat maneuvers: an active autonav adds its rating to accelerating, positioning, ramming (+2) and hiding, Rigger 2 pp. 45–48 (book) or nothing (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__ramRang: Ram range: the target closer than the Acceleration, Rigger 2 p. 47 (book) or no check (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__walls: Walls and barriers: stop at or below Barrier × 20, else break through, Rigger 2 pp. 51–52 (book) or not offered (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__speedCa: Exceeding the Speed: at most 1.5 × the Speed, Rigger 2 p. 22 (book) or no cap (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__stress: Stress: Stress Points, the Stress Rule of One and Stress Tests, Rigger 2 pp. 25–26 (book) or none (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__chase: The Maneuver Score chase: scores on the combat, Hiding and Relocating, Rigger 2 pp. 41–49 (book) or the v0.57.0 positioning chase (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__passeng: Passengers in vehicle combat: no offensive action above the Driver Points, Rigger 2 p. 49 (book) or no limit (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__gunnery: Gunnery rows: relative motion ±1 and Maneuver Score ±1, Rigger 2 p. 57 (book) or the v0.57.0 position modifier (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__passeng: Passenger safety gear: seat belts, APPS and crash cages in crashes, Rigger 2 pp. 50, 128 (book) or none (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__cpCarry: The rigger's Crash Test Control Pool dice also go on the passengers' resistance, Rigger 2 p. 50 (book) or not (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__deadlyP: A Deadly hit on a passenger also does Light to the vehicle, Rigger 2 p. 53 (book) or nothing (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__calledT: Called shots at vehicle parts: at least Moderate (sensors Light, turrets Serious), Rigger 2 p. 53 (book) or any damage (v971)
SR2E.HouseRules.Rule.VDRIVE_V98__datajac: Driving by datajack: +1 Reaction, Rigger 2 p. 124 (book) or none (v971)
SR2E.Tools.chase98.label: Vehicle chase (book rules, GM)
SR2E.Tools.chase98.hint: The Maneuver Scores of a Combat Turn, Hiding, Relocating and hitting a wall (Rigger 2).
SR2E.VDrive98.Tool.poolHint: Control Pool dice each jumped-in rigger puts on this turn's Driver Points Open Test (they don't refresh until the turn ends; at most the skill).
